identity.name: Journal of Bone and Mineral Research
identity.source_note: [main-session: live fetch was bot-blocked/shell at finalize; hash is of a <=12mo Wayback archive snapshot: https://web.archive.org/web/20260306130252id_/https://academic.oup.com/jbmr/pages/general-instructions]

encoding_notes: Publisher migration: JBMR is the ASBMR flagship journal, now published by Oxford University Press (academic.oup.com/jbmr); it was formerly a Wiley title. Live OUP guide read cleanly (TIER_A).

Peer review is single-anonymized (author identity known to reviewers), so no blinding/title-page scrub is required: 'The Journal operates single-anonymized peer review... identity of the authors is known to the editors and to the reviewers.'

references.style='ama' is explicit ('JBMR follows AMA style'). in_text='superscript', order='cited', journal_abbrev='nlm' are the defining AMA norms encoded as formatter targets, NOT independently stated by the guide. Low desk-reject risk because the guide states authors 'may format references in any readable style at submission.' include_doi set false conservatively (guide silent).
et_al_threshold left null — guide does not state it (AMA 11th convention is 6-then-et-al but not stated by this guide).

SCHEMA GAP — display items: most types allow a COMBINED max of 8 display items (tables + figures), which the per-type figures_max/tables_max split cannot represent; both left null. Complex Clinical Challenges is 'usually 2 (1 table + 1 figure), max 3'.
SCHEMA GAP — tiered figure DPI: color halftones 300dpi, grayscale halftones 600dpi, combination/line-art 600-900dpi, monochrome line art 1200dpi. min_dpi encodes the 300 floor only.
Figure formats: guide also lists .svg, which is not in the schema's allowed format enum, so it was omitted from formats[].

SCHEMA GAP — Lay Summary is required for most types (max 100 words for Research/Invited Review/Systematic Review; max 200 for Clinical Trial/Perspective). No schema field exists; not encoded. highlights_required set false (no 'Highlights' feature; lay summary is separate).

Article-type mapping: Research Article->original_research; Clinical Trial omitted (would duplicate original_research; identical limits 6000/300 words, refs 10-50); Invited Review->review (invited only); Systematic Review->systematic_review; Editorial->editorial (invited); Letter to the Editor->letter. OMITTED with no clean slot: Perspective (invited opinion), Task Force, Complex Clinical Challenges (case-based clinical challenge, 3000 words, not currently unsolicited).
JBMR does NOT solicit case reports or case series — it is a bone/mineral research journal, so those OSCRSJ types are absent by design.
title_max_words=15 is a soft target: 'Title must be concise (aim for no more than 15 words)...'

Declarations required unconditionally: data availability, funding, conflict of interest. Ethics approval, patient consent, and clinical trial registration are 'if applicable'. All are placed on the title page.

line_numbers set to 'none' (schema has no null option) — the guide does not require line numbers; layout details (font, size, spacing, margins, page size, alignment) are all unstated by the guide, which defers to general OUP/AMA standards.
2026-07-18 doctrine audit: line_numbers 'none' was a default, not a guide statement — nulled so the engine preserves the author's setting.
